trace_assessment.conclusion: The source render target remained at black after two renderer-ready indexed draws were submitted; the black presenter output is downstream of that already-black source. The evidence does not distinguish guest-requested clear/no effective color writes from draw state, shader, or rasterization producing no visible RGB.
trace_assessment.renderer_attachment_initial_value: The Vulkan render-pass color attachment uses VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR with RGB=0 (alpha=1); an untouched target therefore reads black. This does not prove a guest-issued clear packet.
trace_assessment.per_draw_visibility_follow_up: The renderer now supports opt-in per-submitted-draw non-precise occlusion queries selected with SHIFT_NATIVE_VULKAN_DUMP_DRAW_FRAME. This exact retail frame has not yet been rerun with the query enabled, so no per-draw coverage result is claimed.
trace_assessment.unresolved_startup_draw: A separate draw #0 near process startup had incomplete raster state valid_mask=0x17038; it is not associated with submitted frame 400.
trace_assessment.related_runs_are_not_frame_equivalent: Older frame-400 draw dumps belong to different launches and show different draw sequences; they cannot supply missing state for this black run.

This retail frame-400 source/output measurement is not retail parity evidence: its source and presenter output are black, and no exact-frame per-draw state, occlusion, or pixel-write trace was captured.
